title: Emberveil Entity Shared Definitions (v1)
description: Shared $defs for canonical entity/combat data. The `combatant` def is the authoritative superset of EVERY field that appears on any enemy across src/maps/mapData.js (ENEMIES, ENEMIES_ACT4/5/6, inline ENCOUNTERS enemies, HIDDEN_BOSS_ENCOUNTERS). Field list verified by grepping the live source — see game13/memory/extraction-report.md.

statusEffect.title: Status effect application
statusEffect.description: A status applied on hit / on phase entry. `power`/`duration` are optional because some inline statusOnHit entries omit them (e.g. stun { type,chance,duration } with no power).

statusOnHit.title: statusOnHit — single status OR array of statuses
statusOnHit.description: mapData.js uses BOTH shapes: an array of statusEffect (most ENEMIES) and a single bare statusEffect object (ENEMIES_ACT4/5 void_wraith, reality_shard, etc). Byte-parity requires preserving whichever shape the source used.

combatant.title: Combatant stat block (enemy/boss superset)
combatant.description: Exhaustive field set. additionalProperties:false enforces that no enemy field is silently dropped — if extraction fails validation a field is missing here and must be added (data-loss guard).

combatantOverrides.title: Per-encounter combatant override delta
combatantOverrides.description: Partial combatant — any subset of combatant fields, applied on top of the base enemies.json/bosses.json entry to reproduce a byte-identical inline encounter stat block. Same field set as combatant minus the required[] constraint. A field value of `null` is the DELETE_MARKER: it means the inline encounter literal OMITS that key even though the shared-id base defines it (e.g. inline dragon_whelp has no loot/statusOnHit while ENEMIES_ACT6.dragon_whelp does); resolution removes the key. No combatant field is ever literally null in legacy mapData, so the marker is unambiguous. Contract authored identically in scripts/extract-canonical-data.mjs (applyOverride), scripts/verify-canonical-parity.mjs (resolveCanonGroup), and game13/memory/canonical-data-migration-plan.md.
